Scientific note
Positions come from a Newtonian N-body calculation. Objects are drawn at dramatically enlarged sizes. The black-hole halo is a locator, not observed accretion emission. The 97.8° obliquity affects its drawn spin axis, not orbital motion; no climate or long-term stability is inferred.
